name: veriqa-approval
description: Ask a person to approve risky Claude Code actions in a trusted messenger through Veriqa: tool calls, long command cycles, costly runs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: own-host: your own Veriqa host with a client secret. shared-stand: the shared stand's facade, with a key this installation makes itself.

host_url.title: Host URL
host_url.description: Address of your Veriqa host (own-host mode).

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: The client of the host fragment (own-host mode).

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: The secret of that client (own-host mode).

stand_url.title: Shared stand URL
stand_url.description: Address of the shared stand's facade (shared-stand mode).

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The messenger the approval is answered in, or hop to pick one on the phone.

ttl_seconds.title: Approval lifetime, seconds
ttl_seconds.description: How long a person has to answer: 60 to 1800.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: BCP 47 language of the question; empty for the host's language.

rules_file.title: Rules file
rules_file.description: A rules file of your own; empty for the project's .claude/veriqa-approval.rules.json or the plugin's default.

price_input.title: Input price, USD per million tokens
price_input.description: Used for the cost of a costly run.

price_output.title: Output price, USD per million tokens
price_output.description: Used for the cost of a costly run.
